THE RIVIERA COUNTRY CLUB
Pacific Palisades, CA

The Riviera Country Club is one of the most storied and internationally revered clubs on earth. Since its inception in 1927, Riviera has been a fixture in tournament golf, serving as the annual venue for the Genesis Invitational along with the closing event of the PGA Tour’s West Coast swing. "Hogan's Alley", as Riviera is known, is an architectural masterpiece that highlights the Golden Age of golf course architecture and pays respect to the ambiance and roots of the game.
"I consider it (Riviera) one of the greatest tests of golf."
~ Arnold Palmer
